title: Window's content_scale_mode "Canvas Items" does not work if parent window has gui_embed_subwindows enabled
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the "Canvas Items" value for the `Window` node's `content_scale_mode` property, it appears to be the same as "Disabled" when the root node (also a `Window`) has `gui_embed_subwindows` enabled (done through project settings, default is `true`).

The same issue does not happen with the "Viewport" scale mode, which leads me to believe that this a bug. When `gui_embed_subwindows` is `false`, the scaling for "Canvas Items" works correctly (though only on runtime, the preview in the editor is the same as above).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make a window node
2. Drag icon.svg into the scene as a child of the window and position it so that you can see it
3. Set content scale size to a small value (like 100, 100)
4. set size to a larger value (like 400, 400)
5. set mode to canvas items
6. observe that nothing changed
7. set mode to viewport
8. observe that it has been scaled
9. set mode back to canvas items
10. Go into project settings and change embed subwindows to false
11. run the scene with your window node
12. observe that it has been scaled

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[window_canvas_items_scaling_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24399553/window_canvas_items_scaling_test.zip)
